description.value: Grandpa's Heart at Nicklen Lake is a lakefront cabin resort set on two acres of Okanagan territory near Vernon, BC, offering seven named cabins of varying sizes from bunks to deluxe two-bedroom units. Guests can relax in a large gazebo overlooking Nicklen Lake, rent rowboats, or participate in occasional wellness and cultural programming. The property is dog-friendly and promotes a personalized, retreat-style experience away from city life.

address.value: 23 Goat Mountain Road, Vernon, BC V1B3M6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at grandpasheart.ca is clearly for this property — same address (23 Goat Mountain Road, Vernon, BC V1B 3M6) confirmed — and shows an active lakefront cabin resort operating under the name 'Grandpa's Heart at Nicklen Lake', not 'Nicklen Lake Resort' as listed in OSM. The website phone numbers (604.799.8851 / 236.990.9974) differ from the OSM phone (+1-250-549-0290), flagged as a discrepancy. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, laundry, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Nicklen Lake Resort' but the website consistently uses 'Grandpa's Heart at Nicklen Lake' throughout all pages.
Phone discrepancy: OSM phone is +1-250-549-0290 but the website shows 604-799-8851 and 236-990-9974 as the contact numbers. OSM phone may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating lakefront cabin resort with active booking system and confirmed address. A useful stopover accommodation for touring cyclists in the Vernon area.
